walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.channels: walmart.com and the Walmart app: pickup, delivery and shipping (shipping only for items sold and shipped by Walmart.com)
walmart.limits: Only items bought in store or marked 'sold & shipped by Walmart.com'; Marketplace (third-party) seller items excluded. SNAP cannot pay delivery fees or tips. State-specific item restrictions apply. Pickup/delivery availability depends on the local store.

sources.what: Walmart SNAP Online FAQ (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'You can use your SNAP EBT card at all participating Walmart stores and online for pickup, delivery, or shipping'; 'SNAP EBT benefits cannot be used to buy items sold by Marketplace sellers'.
Walmart location facts (as of 31 Oct 2026): US location list covers all 50 states plus DC (and Puerto Rico).

walmart.note: Because shipped Walmart.com orders also take SNAP, coverage is effectively nationwide. Location-facts page lists DC but gives no per-state count, so the DC store count was not checked; DC residents can still use shipping.

amazon.name: Amazon (incl. Amazon Fresh)
amazon.channels: Amazon.com shipped orders, Amazon Fresh delivery and pickup, and Whole Foods Market delivery/pickup on Amazon; no Prime needed
amazon.limits: SNAP cannot pay shipping, delivery fees or tips. Per secondary sources, SNAP only covers SNAP-eligible items sold by Amazon (Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods); third-party seller items are excluded (Cash EBT, a separate benefit, can buy third-party items in 22 states plus DC). Amazon Fresh delivery/pickup exists only in some metros; elsewhere it is shipped Amazon.com orders. Some states restrict items such as soda and candy from 1 Jan 2026.

sources.what: Amazon newsroom (published 13 Sep 2023, updated 29 Dec 2025): SNAP EBT offering 'is available to those eligible nationwide' on Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh and Whole Foods Market; card cannot pay shipping, delivery fees or tips.
Amazon 'Pay with EBT' help page. Opened 22 Nov 2026 but amazon.com served an 'Access restricted' notice to automated agents, so its text was not read.
Secondary source (from search result, not opened): third-party seller items do not qualify for SNAP; used only to fill the third-party-seller gap.

amazon.note: Acceptance and nationwide reach come from Amazon's own newsroom. The third-party-seller exclusion comes from secondary sources, since amazon.com blocks automated reading of its help page.

aldi.name: ALDI (US)
aldi.channels: aldi.us website and ALDI app (Instacart-powered storefront): delivery and pickup at participating stores; also ALDI on the Instacart app
aldi.limits: Only items sold by ALDI.us qualify. SNAP cannot pay tips, fees or non-eligible items; a credit/debit card is needed for those. Only participating online pickup/delivery locations.

sources.what: ALDI SNAP EBT payment page (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'ALDI accepts SNAP benefits via EBT cards at all participating ALDI online pickup & delivery locations'; 'Only items sold by ALDI.us are eligible to be paid with SNAP'.
ALDI store locator (opened 22 Nov 2026; stores.aldi.us redirects here): stores in 40 states plus DC, e.g. Maine (1), Nevada (5), DC (3).
Instacart EBT SNAP page names ALDI among participating retailers.

aldi.note: State list is the store footprint; a few new single-store states (ME, NV) may not yet offer pickup/delivery. Some converted Southeastern Grocers stores may be mid-rebrand.

costco.name: Costco
costco.channels: Costco Same-Day delivery only (sameday.costco.com and Costco on the Instacart app, fulfilled by Instacart); membership required
costco.limits: EBT is NOT accepted on Costco.com (shipped and 2-day CostcoGrocery orders). Same-Day only; SNAP cannot pay fees or tips. Costco's own customer-service FAQ confirms EBT in all warehouses but says nothing about online use.

sources.what: Instacart EBT SNAP page (opened 22 Nov 2026) names Costco among participating retailers.

News (GOBankingRates via AOL, 2 Feb 2024): Instacart spokesperson says 'Costco will be accepting EBT SNAP via Instacart and through sameday.costco.com'. Used to fill the gap left by Costco's own pages.
Costco customer service search for EBT (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'All our warehouse locations accept EBT cards'; no online statement.
Costco warehouses by state (opened 22 Nov 2026): warehouses in 47 states; none in RI, WV or WY; DC not listed.

costco.note: No Costco-owned page says Same-Day takes EBT (sameday.costco.com help sits behind a sign-in/guest gate). DC is included because Same-Day delivers there from nearby MD/VA warehouses (USDA also lists Costco for DC). RI/WV/WY border addresses might get delivery but are excluded. Same-Day coverage in AK and HI not verified.

whole_foods.name: Whole Foods Market
whole_foods.channels: Delivery and pickup ordered through Amazon (amazon.com/wholefoods, the Whole Foods tab in the Amazon app, or wholefoodsmarket.com which hands off to Amazon)
whole_foods.limits: Only SNAP-eligible products; SNAP cannot pay shipping, delivery or service fees. Not every in-store item is sold online.

sources.what: Whole Foods FAQ (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'SNAP EBT payments are accepted for SNAP eligible products on delivery and pickup orders in U.S. Whole Foods Market locations'; links to Amazon SNAP page; fees not payable with SNAP.
Amazon newsroom: SNAP works for Whole Foods Market grocery delivery and pickup on Amazon.
Secondary footprint source (1 Jun 2024): only AK, DE, ND, SD, VT and WV have no Whole Foods.
Secondary (from search result, not opened; dated 19 Oct 2026): the same six states still lack a store.

whole_foods.note: Acceptance is official. The footprint comes from secondary sources because the Whole Foods store locator has no state list readable without JavaScript. Single-store states (e.g. MT, MS, WY, ID, IA, ME) are the least certain.

kroger.name: Kroger
kroger.channels: kroger.com and the Kroger app: Pickup and Delivery (Kroger's own delivery or Instacart-fulfilled delivery booked through Kroger)
kroger.limits: No SNAP for Ship (shipped) orders. SNAP cannot pay tips, delivery, ordering or convenience fees. SNAP is no longer taken at curbside; you must pay online at checkout. WIC is not accepted online.

sources.what: Kroger SNAP EBT FAQ (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'The Kroger Co. Family of Stores accepts SNAP EBT at all participating pickup locations and through delivery on the Kroger website and Kroger mobile app'; 'we currently don't support SNAP EBT payment for ship orders'.
Kroger press release (25 Oct 2023): EBT 'enabled for Pickup and Delivery orders at every Kroger Family of Stores location'.
Kroger-banner store directory (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'Kroger has 1234 grocery stores in 16 states': AL, AR, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MI, MO, MS, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV.
Kroger 10-K FY2025 (filed 31 Mar 2026): supermarkets 'under a variety of local banner names in 35 states and the District of Columbia'.
Last resort: Nov 2025 announcement closing Groveland FL, Pleasant Prairie WI and Frederick MD fulfillment centers and ending Kroger delivery in Florida.

kroger.note: The Kroger-named state list comes straight from Kroger's directory. banner_states (19 states plus DC) is 10-K total footprint minus the Kroger states, with banners mapped from general knowledge: Fred Meyer AK/ID/OR/WA, Fry's AZ, Ralphs/Food 4 Less CA, King Soopers/City Market CO/WY, Smith's NV/NM/UT/MT/ID/WY, Dillons KS, Baker's NE, Harris Teeter DE/DC/FL/MD/NC, Pick 'n Save/Metro Market WI. That mapping is medium confidence. Kroger-branded delivery in FL (Ocado) ended 2025 to 2026.

safeway.name: Safeway
safeway.channels: safeway.com and the Safeway app: delivery and Drive Up & Go pickup; also Safeway on the Instacart app
safeway.limits: SNAP cannot pay delivery or service fees, tips or non-eligible items; a backup card is required. WIC is not accepted online. Only where the store offers delivery or Drive Up & Go.

sources.what: Safeway SNAP guide (updated Apr 2026; safeway.com returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so this is taken from a search-result summary): Safeway accepts SNAP EBT for delivery and Drive Up & Go wherever it offers those services.
Albertsons Cos. press release (25 Jul 2022): EBT SNAP online via its websites and apps and its Instacart virtual stores, launched at Albertsons, Safeway, Jewel-Osco, Vons and Pavilions.
Safeway store directory (fetched 22 Nov 2026): Safeway-banner stores in AK, AZ, CA, CO, DE, HI, ID, MD, MT, NE, NV, NM, OR, SD, VA, WA, WY and DC.
Albertsons Cos. 10-K FY2025 (as of 28 Feb 2026): 2,244 stores in 35 states plus DC, with per-state counts (basis for banner_states).
Instacart EBT SNAP page marks Safeway stores 'Accepts EBT'.

safeway.note: Safeway's own SNAP pages block automated access, so the acceptance wording comes from a search snippet plus the 2022 Albertsons release. banner_states are states in the 10-K with no Safeway-banner store: e.g. Albertsons/Randalls/Tom Thumb TX, Jewel-Osco IL/IN/IA, ACME NJ/NY/PA/CT, Shaw's/Star Market New England, Albertsons AR/LA/ND/OK/UT.

publix.name: Publix
publix.channels: Publix delivery and curbside pickup, fulfilled by Instacart (Publix site/app ordering hands off to Instacart; also the Instacart app)
publix.limits: Through Instacart only: SNAP and SUN Bucks yes, EBT Cash no. SNAP cannot pay fees, tips, taxes or deposits; a credit/debit card is required. Online prices are higher than in-store.

sources.what: Instacart EBT SNAP page (opened 22 Nov 2026) names Publix among participating EBT SNAP retailers; EBT cash not accepted.
Instacart press release (Apr 2021, from search result): EBT SNAP live at Publix chainwide for delivery and pickup.

Publix FAQ URL (opened 22 Nov 2026): automated access got Publix's generic page, which has no EBT wording but names the 8 states with stores (FL, GA, AL, SC, NC, TN, VA, KY). The Instacart delivery/pickup wording comes from a search-result snippet of this URL.

publix.note: No publix.com page found that itself states EBT is accepted online; acceptance rests on Instacart's pages. Kentucky (newest state) is not on USDA's list and its online availability was not separately checked.

sprouts.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
sprouts.channels: shop.sprouts.com and the Sprouts app (Instacart-powered): pickup and delivery; also Sprouts on the Instacart app
sprouts.limits: No EBT Cash online. A credit/debit card must also be on the account for fees, bottle deposits, taxes, tips and non-eligible items. Holiday meals and catering bought with EBT must be paid in store.

sources.what: Sprouts FAQ (opened 22 Nov 2026): 'Sprouts customers can pay for online orders with a valid EBT card, in full or in part in all Sprouts locations'; no EBT Cash online.
Sprouts store directory (opened 22 Nov 2026): stores in 25 states, including New York (2) and Wyoming (1).
Sprouts press release (2022, from search result): EBT SNAP for same-day delivery and pickup via Instacart, then 23 states.

sprouts.note: NY and WY are newer markets, added since the 2022 launch (23 states). The FAQ says all locations accept it, but online service at the newest stores was not separately checked.

gopuff.name: Gopuff
gopuff.channels: Gopuff app (iOS/Android), gopuff.com, and the Gopuff Convenience store on Uber Eats: delivery only
gopuff.limits: SNAP-eligible items only, combined with another card for the rest. Not accepted on Gopuff Liquor & More storefronts in Uber Eats. Only where Gopuff has a nearby micro-fulfillment center (metro areas, not statewide).

sources.what: Gopuff newsroom (1 Nov 2024): SNAP accepted for eligible online purchases 'at Gopuff locations nationwide' across several hundred micro-fulfillment centers.
Gopuff newsroom (16 Jul 2025): SNAP on the website, apps and the Gopuff store on Uber Eats; not on Liquor & More storefronts.
Gopuff blog (30 Dec 2025): sample city links in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MA, NV, NY, NC, PA, TN, TX, WA, DC; not a full list.

USDA FNS state retailer pages, Wayback snapshots Dec 2025 to May 2026 already saved in this repo (data/reference/usda_snap_online.csv and snapshots/; this URL is one example row, not refetched today). They list 'Go-Puff' in 37 states plus DC. Used as the state list because Gopuff publishes none.

gopuff.note: Gopuff says 'nationwide' but publishes no state list, and its location directory sits behind a Cloudflare bot check. The states are USDA's Go-Puff listings, which agree with Gopuff's sample cities. Coverage is metro-only, so most of each state may be unserved.
